causes.network_outage: Murraylink flows were forced counter-price at around 70 MW from South Australia into Victoria at 6.30 am due to a planned outage of the Rowville to South Morang line.
causes.rebids: Rebidding for commercial and technical reasons contributed to some of the high prices on 26 January and 27 January
